description: This PHP source file defines the SugarFieldWysiwyg class, a custom field type for SuiteCRM (a SugarCRM derivative). It extends the base SugarFieldBase class to provide WYSIWYG editor capabilities (using TinyMCE) for rich text editing within the CRM's interface. The class includes methods for rendering detail and edit views, with the latter initializing TinyMCE and handling display parameters.

classes.name: SugarFieldWysiwyg
classes.description: A class that provides WYSIWYG editor functionality for a custom CRM field, extending the base SugarField class.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares the Smarty template for displaying the WYSIWYG field in detail view, disabling inline editing.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares the Smarty template for editing the WYSIWYG field, initializing TinyMCE with appropriate configuration and handling potential errors.
